mechanism: Sacubitril's neprilysin inhibition may increase bradykinin and natriuretic peptide levels, potentially affecting iron absorption and increasing hypotension risk; ferrous sulfate may chelate with sacubitril metabolites or affect gastric pH-dependent absorption.
action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate; separate administration by 2+ hours; consider monitoring hemoglobin/ferritin levels and sacubitril efficacy during concurrent use.
